meta.name: deploy-to-vercel
meta.description: Deploy applications and websites to Vercel. Use when the user requests deployment actions like "deploy my app", "deploy and give me the link", "push this live", or "create a preview deployment".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 一键将应用部署到 Vercel 并获取链接
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要将应用快速部署到 Vercel 并获取预览链接
copy.tagline_en: Deploy your app to Vercel and get a live link with one command
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently deploy apps to Vercel and need instant preview URLs

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你把项目部署到 Vercel，并返回预览链接。它会自动检查项目状态，选择最合适的部署方式（如 Git 推送、CLI 部署或免认证脚本）。
howto.when: 当你要求部署应用，比如说“部署我的应用”、“部署并给我链接”、“发布上线”或“创建预览部署”时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个项目部署到 Vercel，给我预览链接。
say.note: Claude 会检查项目状态并选择最佳方式部署。

say.text: 部署当前文件夹到 Vercel 预览环境。
say.note: Claude 会使用免认证脚本部署并返回链接。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can deploy your project to Vercel and return a preview URL. It automatically checks the project state and chooses the best method (git push, CLI deploy, or no-auth script).
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to deploy an app, e.g., "deploy my app", "deploy and give me the link", "push this live", or "create a preview deployment".

say_en.text: Deploy this project to Vercel and give me the preview URL.
say_en.note: Claude will check state and deploy.

say_en.text: Deploy the current folder to Vercel preview.
say_en.note: Claude uses the no-auth fallback script.
